func NewHash(h hash.Hash, space UUID, data []byte, version int) UUID {
	h.Reset()
	h.Write(space[:]) //nolint:errcheck
	h.Write(data)     //nolint:errcheck
	s := h.Sum(nil)
	var uuid UUID
	copy(uuid[:], s)
	uuid[6] = (uuid[6] & 0x0f) | uint8((version&0xf)<<4)
	uuid[8] = (uuid[8] & 0x3f) | 0x80 // RFC 4122 variant
	return uuid
}
